subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · 3e · Grammaire · Voix passive et relatives
description: Règles et automatismes — voix passive et relatives.

cards.front: Mets au passif : People speak English here.
cards.back: English is spoken here.

cards.front: Mets au passif : They built it in 1920.
cards.back: It was built in 1920.

cards.front: Mets au passif : Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.
cards.back: Hamlet was written by Shakespeare.

cards.front: Mets au passif : They do not allow phones.
cards.back: Phones are not allowed.

cards.front: Mets au passif : Do they grow tea here?
cards.back: Is tea grown here?

cards.front: Complète : The activist ___ spoke was convincing.
cards.back: The activist who spoke was convincing.

cards.front: Complète : The film ___ won is British.
cards.back: The film which/that won is British.

cards.front: Complète : The author ___ book I read is Canadian.
cards.back: The author whose book I read is Canadian.

cards.front: Complète : This is the city ___ she was born.
cards.back: This is the city where she was born.

cards.front: Peut-on omettre that : The book that I bought ?
cards.back: Oui : The book I bought. Le pronom est complément.

cards.front: Quelle consigne grammaticale conduit à cette réponse correcte : « English is spoken here. » ?
cards.back: Mets au passif : People speak English here.

cards.back: Mets au passif : Shakespeare wrote Hamlet.

cards.back: Mets au passif : They do not allow phones.

cards.back: Mets au passif : Do they grow tea here?

cards.back: Complète : The activist ___ spoke was convincing.

cards.front: Quelle consigne grammaticale conduit à cette réponse correcte : « The film which/that won is British. » ?
cards.back: Complète : The film ___ won is British.

cards.front: Quelle consigne grammaticale conduit à cette réponse correcte : « The author whose book I read is Canadian. » ?
cards.back: Complète : The author ___ book I read is Canadian.

cards.front: Quelle consigne grammaticale conduit à cette réponse correcte : « This is the city where she was born. » ?
cards.back: Complète : This is the city ___ she was born.
